introduction: South Carolina SNAP applications use the DSS Benefits Portal or a county office’s paper, mail or fax route. A caseworker reviews eligibility and interviews applicants.
description: South Carolina SNAP applications use the DSS Benefits Portal or a county office’s paper, mail or fax route. A caseworker reviews eligibility and interviews applicants.

sections.who: DSS assesses household circumstances and finances. Working people, older adults and people experiencing homelessness can qualify under the program rules.
sections.get: Approved benefits help buy eligible foods through EBT.
sections.docs:
• Household and identity information.
  • Income and requested expenses.
  • Evidence listed by the interview worker.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through DSS

    Use the application page.

  2. Complete the review

    Answer interview and verification requests. Ask about expedited help if food is urgently needed.

  3. Read the decision

    Check certification dates and EBT instructions.
sections.after: Follow reporting and renewal notices. Check current Healthy Food SC guidance for the announced November 2026 purchase-rule change.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Application and simplified routes, SNAP review and eligibility, Current portal policy notice. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is the portal estimate a final decision?
No. DSS says only the agency can determine the actual benefit.
The application page links ESAP and the SSI-related SCCAP project.
When is the new food-policy change announced?
The current DSS portal announces November 1, 2026; check its implementation guidance.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
